name: Seoul
living: the Han River bridge's rainbow lights slowly cycle along its arches
the rainbow reflections shimmer and ripple on the river
Namsan Tower's green shaft glows and its observation ring lights twinkle, a red light blinking on its mast
the palace gate's lanterns and arches glow warmly, breathing softly
apartment tower windows flicker on and off across the hillside
a few cherry petals drift down from the pink trees beside the stands
stars twinkle in the indigo sky and the purple clouds drift slowly
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe with a gentle lens flare
cars' headlights crawl across the bridge deck now and then (sprite)
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
